description: A SQL-UDF body is classified as a QUERY versus a bare scalar EXPRESSION by PARSING it - is it a queryStatement? - and not by a startsWith('SELECT') string prefix. So a WITH ... SELECT CTE body is recognised as a query, where the old prefix check fell through to expression evaluation and failed. A plain SELECT body and an expression body ride along as the two controls. Converted 1:1 from scripting/SqlUdfQueryBodyTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE FUNCTION sel_one() RETURNS INTEGER AS 'SELECT 1'
CREATE FUNCTION cte_five() RETURNS INTEGER AS 'WITH c AS (SELECT 5 AS v) SELECT v FROM c'
CREATE FUNCTION dbl(x INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER AS 'x * 2'
